modifiedUpstreamFiles.nuxt.config.ts: Inject public environment/version metadata from the root declarative domain contract, expose contentSource/siteName from GEEK_FORUM_CONTENT_DIR (GEEK_FORUM_SOURCE=demo wins) and loginMode (site unless GEEK_FORUM_LOGIN=demo on the demo seed), and set app.baseURL from GEEK_FORUM_BASE_PATH so the static build can be served under the portal domain /forum path; prerender /llms.txt and /t/<id>.md for every seed topic (answered by server/middleware/forum-markdown.ts) so the static build ships them as files; no static head title. Local is not preview, and metadata does not authorize deployment. Dev only: nitro.devProxy forwards /auth and /api/public/org to the local core server (127.0.0.1:3000) with Origin set to the portal origin 127.0.0.1:5173, so the forum dev server can read the site-wide session, sign out through the core Origin check and read the 称号/部门 display data for TitleBadge; not part of the static build (online the forum shares the core origin).

modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/ForumHeader.vue: Site name from content source; retains the animated TxTuffLogoStroke component. Under the site-wide login the forum has no login of its own: the header reads /auth/me; signed in shows the GitHub avatar with 控制台 / 退出; signed out shows a single 用 GitHub 登录 button (登录 on narrow screens, same accessible name) that goes to /auth/github with return_to back to the current forum page including query and hash; in dev the login and 控制台 go through the portal origin 127.0.0.1:5173. Login mode is separate from the content source (runtime public loginMode): the site-wide GitHub login is the default for every build, including the deployed demo-seed images; only scripts/forum.mjs sets GEEK_FORUM_LOGIN=demo for the upstream CDP suites and the local sample preview, which keep the upstream mock login unchanged.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/ForumSidebar.vue: Workspace slot is a TxCardItem link with the official 极客班 logo instead of the generic letter chip (decorative image, accessible name = visible site name); the site blurb sits in its description, not subtitle, because the upstream shell check reads the signed-in footer card as the sidebar's only subtitle; fine-tuned font sizes; category rows show the category icon with upstream's TxBadge colour dot on its corner (both cues, upstream dot assertion intact); no 重置示例数据 under the site-wide login (nothing is kept in this browser). modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/PostCard.vue: Wrap Markdown view in an overflow container for mobile table/code scrolling; the copied permalink and the author TxCellLink href carry app.baseURL (useAppLink); the author row shows the 极客班 TitleBadge when the author has a title, the upstream role badge otherwise.

modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/data/permissions.ts: Adds hasForumCapability(user, capability): admin/moderator by role hold every forum capability as before, anyone else holds what their 极客班 title carries (titleForumCapabilities: the forum part of the server's default title packs (ROLE_BASE: 提督 and 舰长 everything) plus the default department packs). These packs stay local defaults: the server publishes no permission packs to the forum (GET /api/public/org carries display data only), so a pack the 提督 edits in the console does not reach the forum until its backend exists (#57). isStaff = forum.post.moderate (edit/delete others' posts, reply in closed topics); pinTopic reads forum.topic.pin and closeTopic reads forum.topic.close. Demo permissions only, not an authorization boundary; every other ForumAction rule is unchanged.
